entities.name: Agnes Meyer Driscoll
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Agnes Meyer Driscoll, known as "Miss Aggie" or "Madame X'", was an American
cryptanalyst during both World War I and World War II and was known as "the first lady of naval cryptology."
